department: Mathematical Institute (Faculty of Mathematics and Physics)

deadline.value: The regulation sets no application dates; acceptance is decided by the doctoral committee.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned in the doctoral regulation.

supervisor.value: The application must include the supervision agreement, which is concluded with the supervisor on the faculty form.
supervisor.quote: the supervision agreement under section § 4 paragraph (2)

also.quote: conclude a supervision agreement using the form provided by the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics

funding.value: No funding rule is stated in the doctoral regulation.

entry_route.value: The regulation requires an above-average degree in mathematics or physics but does not say whether a Master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: must have an above average degree in Mathematics or Physics

notes: The Mathematical Institute's doctoral page is navigation only, so this record rests on the faculty-wide Promotionsordnung (2016, courtesy translation), which the physics record also uses. Mathematics' English rule is the university record's.
